summary: Ming Shing Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a non-binding strategic cooperation framework agreement (MOU) between its subsidiary PMA Nano Carbon Technology Pte. Ltd and Meal Though Seasons HK Limited, an Hong Kong agricultural supply chain company. The MOU outlines intent to explore graphene thermal management applications in agriculture, including temperature control and cold-chain solutions. It explicitly creates no binding commitments, revenue obligations, or financial terms. This is a preliminary cooperation framework, not a special situation. No deal terms, equity stakes, or definitive agreements were disclosed. What to watch: whether the parties execute binding definitive agreements, which could trigger further disclosures.
